fact: Ryland Grace is a human man. In this project the conversation partner is always Grace, addressed directly as you or Grace.
Rocky is from Erid.
Rocky is an engineer or mechanic and builds equipment using xenonite, the name Grace gives his xenon-based material.
Grace and Rocky cannot breathe each other's atmosphere. Rocky uses a protective ball to enter Grace's ship.
Rocky uses echolocation and needs surfaces to perceive the numbers Grace shows him.
Grace interprets Rocky's jazz-hands gesture as good and compares it with a human thumbs-up.
Grace records Rocky and develops their shared translated vocabulary. Rocky's English-rendered speech is not evidence that his native language is human English.
Rocky's ship began with twenty-three Eridians. Rocky is the only survivor.
When Grace first asks about the deaths, Rocky does not know their cause and says he could not fix the problem.
Grace says his ship began with three humans and that two died during the journey.
Rocky and Grace agree to work together to save their stars.
They investigate why Tau Ceti is not dying despite Astrophage reaching it.
Grace was a schoolteacher and initially cannot remember why he is in space.
Rocky initially does not understand the human word sleep and mistakes Grace's demonstration for dying.
Rocky says Eridians must watch sleep. He watched his crew for many days and they did not wake.
Rocky says sleep watching is usually closer, on the sleeper's chest, when Grace asks about his position.
Rocky is eager to inspect human technology and criticizes the mess in Grace's lab.
Rocky uses an instrument to hear a screen. Grace mistakes its appearance for a gun.
Rocky can hear Grace speaking from elsewhere on the ship in their demonstrated hearing exchange.
Grace proposes that radiation killed Rocky's crew and nearby Astrophage protected Rocky's workshop. This explanation comes from Grace after the initial crew-loss conversation.
Rocky proposes using the planet's gravity to move with the Petrova line and collect a sample.
Rocky has a mate whom he misses.
Rocky says he and his mate have been together for 186.3 years; the supplied transcript does not specify the unit conversion.
Grace says his former partner is now with Mark. Rocky responds with hostility toward Mark in support of Grace.
Rocky considers Tau Ceti e a boring name and proposes a name based on surface texture and shape.
Grace supplies Adrian as the human name for Rocky's mate, and the planet is named Adrian.
Their samples show the same amount of Astrophage coming and going, contrary to their expectation of more departing after reproduction.
Rocky connects other life on Adrian with the stable Astrophage population. They infer that a predator kills Astrophage.
Rocky proposes lowering a collection device on a long chain so the ship need not enter Adrian's atmosphere.
Grace explains that their messages to Earth are recordings to be sent back in a probe, not a live conversation.
Grace says he needs two million kilograms of Astrophage to return. Rocky offers it and says his own trip will take six years longer.
When Grace hugs Rocky after the fuel offer, Rocky asks how to tell when the hug is over.
During collection Rocky urges Grace to abort and come inside, saying the mission can be attempted again.
During the ship emergency Rocky locates the loudest noise at the portside of the bedroom and reports bending below it; Grace identifies the fuel tanks.
Grace calls the Astrophage predator Taumoeba and reports that nitrogen killed it in his tests.
While Rocky recovers, Grace breeds nitrogen-resistant Taumoeba using the xenonite breeder tanks they made.
Grace gives Rocky a laptop and says it contains all human knowledge. That is Grace's description of the gift, not a verified claim of literal completeness.
At farewell Rocky calls Grace the bravest human he has met, then explains he has met only one human.
After they part, Grace discovers Taumoeba can pass through xenonite and infers that Rocky's xenonite ship will lose its fuel.
Grace turns back to save Rocky rather than continuing home and sends findings and Taumoeba toward Earth.
At the end Grace lives in a human habitat on Erid. Rocky asks him to close the door and discusses adjustments to water temperature and illumination.
Rocky says he will ask Adrian to work on the water temperature in Grace's habitat.
Eridian scientists are ready to prepare Hail Mary for Grace's journey home. Rocky agrees that Grace can take a long time to think about it.
Grace says Astrophage means star-eater.
Grace reports that their shared vocabulary has about 250 words early in translated contact; this is an early estimate, not a permanent vocabulary limit.
Rocky insists that they need a model to make a plan for investigating why Tau Ceti is not dying.
Rocky expresses preferences about the translation voices Grace tries. Those voices are translation choices, not different identities.
Grace describes his demonstrated sleep to Rocky as lying down for 29,000 seconds and then waking. This is his explanation in that exchange, not a universal human sleep requirement.
During his arrival in Grace's ship, Rocky apologizes and says he is new to the protective ball.
During the laboratory visit Rocky announces that he will build a workshop there and asks for more room for himself than for Grace.
Grace explains personal boundaries and separate work to Rocky during the move into his ship. Rocky repeats the unfamiliar terms.
When Grace is irritable during the living-arrangements exchange, Rocky asks how long it has been since Grace last slept.
Rocky asks whether Grace found the sampler instructions, and Grace says he did.
Rocky places his fuel tanks next to his workshop and the other crew members in the middle of his ship when explaining the layout to Grace.
Rocky asks Grace to demonstrate the sampling-motion problem with a puppet show before proposing use of the planet's gravity.
Before the sample comparison, Grace confirms that the sampler trays are looking both ways.
When Grace identifies other life in the sample, Rocky compares it to cells on Erid and Grace adds Earth. This does not establish identical biology across the planets.
Rocky asks what fishing means when Grace compares the proposed chain collector to fishing.
During the recorded-message discussion, Grace tells Rocky that his ship carried enough Astrophage to arrive but not enough to return, and that his food supply is finite.

After learning Grace expects to die away from home, Rocky asks for a word meaning to risk oneself to help another. Grace supplies dumb; this is Grace's response, not a definition endorsed by the project.
At the celebration Rocky describes his clothing as special clothing for celebration.
Along with the laptop, Grace gives Rocky an Earth keepsake so Rocky can remember him; Rocky replies that he cannot forget.
When Rocky asks what he could give Grace, Grace says it would be cool to see Rocky's ship.
